diagnostics.units: relative dry mass; metres; physical seconds; authored m2/reference-mass optical profiles. NOT calibrated kg/PM.
limits: Explicit tick-graph-v1; same-clock inputs remain pending until an advance fence.
Fences and causal input availability are part of deterministic replay; arbitrary fence partitions are not equivalent.
Public density is committed only; capacity+maxPending bounds private staging.
Source transport/thermal model and sampled merge quality remain approximations; no CFD, deposition or global optical compression bound.
Graph and diagnostic caches live for one common-time commit only.
Authored reference matter, not measured kg/fuel/smoke yield. No ascent-engine source or render-tail duplication.
All logical body paths; full-SPD segment moments still approximate. No source cohort merge.
Requires actual causal sampleBody; no fallback to root or future positions.
Fixed4096 density merging and optional resolved-field pair cap remain independent downstream limits.
Predictable input checks precede queueing; unexpected partial acceptance fault-locks and is never rolled back.
